title: Low-dose CT Using Iterative Reconstruction in Patients With Inflammatory Bowel Disease
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to validate the use of a low-dose computed tomography (CT) protocol and facilitate reduced radiation doses in patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). This is to be achieved using new computer software (Iterative Reconstruction and Automatic Tube Modulation) which will enable low-dose CT imaging at doses equivalent to that of an abdominal radiograph.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult patients requiring a CT abdomen for clinical purposes will be included

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pediatric patients
study_population: Patients under the care of the hospital gastrointestinal services including in-patients and outpatients.
